unit: HBS AI Institute (formerly Digital Data Design Institute) (Harvard HBS)

labs.research_summary: A research center launched in 2022 (formerly the Digital Data Design Institute at Harvard) on using AI and digital technology for business and society, organized into faculty-led labs.
labs.join_notes: The Work With Us page lists two current openings: a full-time Research Manager, AI (staff) and a Postdoctoral Fellow in the Laboratory for Innovation Science, both in Boston, applied for through Harvard's careers sites.
labs.notes: No lead, title or general contact address shown on the pages read (Karim R. Lakhani appears in the directory but with no role). The team page is a filterable directory of about 120 profiles (faculty, affiliates, council-type names, staff) without titles, so no count. The About page says 30+ faculty and six communities of practice.
